sample_unit: AI-generated responses to IVC filter patient education questions

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid, Gunning Fog, Flesch Reading Ease) of AI-generated IVC filter patient education materials
links.effect: ChatGPT mean Gunning Fog 17.76 ± 1.62; Copilot lowest at 11.58 ± 1.55; mean Flesch-Kincaid for both cohorts did not meet recommended U.S. grade reading levels.
links.quote: Nevertheless, the mean Flesch-Kincaid readability for both cohorts does not meet the recommended U.S. grade reading levels.

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated patient education text relative to recommended reading levels
links.effect: Both ChatGPT and Copilot outputs exceeded recommended grade levels; Copilot more readable than ChatGPT (Flesch Reading Ease p = 8.70408 × 10^-8; power 0.392).
links.quote: Nevertheless, the mean Flesch-Kincaid readability for both cohorts does not meet the recommended U.S. grade reading levels.

screen.reason: Evaluates the readability of patient education text generated by ChatGPT and Copilot for inferior vena cava filters using standard reading level metrics, without testing an operational safeguard or deployment practice.
